title: Cool Blaze Slayer Pillar for Hypixel Slyblock
description: Cool Blaze Slayer Pillar Resource Pack for Hypixel Slyblock
body:
This Resourcepack make Blaze Slayer pillar look cool! Textures are changed only in places where everyone usually fight Inferno Demonlord. 

**[FIRMAMENT](https://modrinth.com/mod/firmament) is Required**

But if your Firmament version is < 3.10.0 and you have Sodium, than textures are changed everywhere in crimson isle.

Textures changed:
- Brown Terracotta -> Chiseled Blaze Nether Brick lower part
- Red Terracotta -> Chiseled Blaze Nether Brick upper part
- Orange Terracotta -> Chiseled Pigman Nether Brick
- Yellow Terracotta -> Chiseled Wither Skeleton Nether Brick


[Check my NEW pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/arkudiis-detailed-hypixel-skyblock) for Hypixel Skyblock!
